name: Dinner Rush
announcement: A queue forms outside - dinner rush!
description: Guests arrive much faster while the rush lasts.

name: Health Inspector
announcement: A health inspector is snooping around. The Lounge stays shut.
description: The Last Meal Lounge cannot be used until they leave.

name: Incognito Critic
announcement: A food critic is dining incognito - every course counts.
description: Serving courses earns double renown while they watch.

name: Generous Evening
announcement: The room is in a generous mood - tips run double.
description: Satisfied guests tip double while the mood lasts.

name: Late Supper
announcement: The late crowd arrives in a rush - keep the pass moving!
description: Guests arrive quickly while the late supper lasts.

name: Chef's Table
announcement: A chef's table watches every plate. Make the service sing.
description: Serving courses earns a renown bonus while the table watches.
